episodes.synopsis: The spring garden party concludes without incident. Maomao returns to her regular life as Concubine Gyokuyou’s taster. Meanwhile, novels become popular in the rear palace. Maomao wonders how this came to be, as novels were typically considered low-class. But behind the scenes lies Jinshi and his goals as manager of the rear palace.
episodes.title: Maomao and Maomao

episodes.synopsis: The caravan stirs up excitement in the inner palace. The merchants bring all kinds of goods. However, something gives Maomao a bad feeling.
episodes.title: Caravan

episodes.synopsis: A concubine passes away, and a woman goes missing. Jinshi sends Maomao to investigate - not these incidents, but mushrooms growing in the rear palace.
episodes.title: Corpse Fungus

episodes.synopsis: The special envoy from a foreign land gifts mirrors - a rarity in this country - to the high concubines. However, they bring mysteries as well.
episodes.title: Mirror

episodes.synopsis: In order to realize the seemingly impossible request from the foreign envoy, Maomao speaks to the “Moon Fairy” herself.
episodes.title: The Moon Fairy

episodes.synopsis: The woman from the clinic finds out that Maomao knows a thing or two about medicine, and asks for her help.
episodes.title: The Crystal Pavilion, for the Third Time

episodes.synopsis: Maomao directs her curiosity towards an old, oddly-shaped building.
episodes.title: The Shrine of Choosing

episodes.synopsis: Maomao's reputation for resolving conflicts reaches the empress dowager, who will ask for her help to unravel a mystery that won't leave her mind.
episodes.title: The Empress Dowager

episodes.synopsis: Maomao's investigation of the "curse" reveals more about the late emperor than anticipated.
episodes.title: The Late Emperor

episodes.synopsis: Maomao joins some women exchanging scary stories on a hot summer night to provide chills.
episodes.title: A Ghost Story

episodes.synopsis: Jinshi goes on a hunting trip, and brings Maomao along. He seems ready to share his secret with her.
episodes.title: The Hunt

episodes.synopsis: Maomao discovers Jinshi's secret. She wants nothing to do with whatever the politics behind it is.
episodes.title: Ka Zuigetsu

episodes.synopsis: Xiaolan's term of service is almost up, so she must find a new job. Maomao and Shisui decide to help.
episodes.title: The Baths

episodes.synopsis: Concubine Lishu reports sightings of a ghost in the baths in her pavilion. Maomao goes to investigate.
episodes.title: The Dancing Ghost

episodes.synopsis: Xiaolan accidentally ruins an expensive block of ice. Maomao comes up with a delicious backup plan.
episodes.title: Ice

episodes.synopsis: Luomen returns to the rear palace. His observations trigger Maomao's curiosity.
episodes.title: Festering Resentment

episodes.synopsis: Suirei smuggles Maomao and Shisui out of the rear palace. Jinshi begins to search for Maomao.
episodes.title: The Fox Village

episodes.synopsis: Maomao has been missing for ten days now. Jinshi's investigations lead him to a forgotten graveyard.
episodes.title: Lantern Plant

episodes.synopsis: The village holds a festival. Maomao attends, and Shisui introduces some of the village's history to her.
episodes.title: Festival

episodes.synopsis: Maomao is taken to a mountain stronghold, where many of the secrets of the Shi clan are revealed to her.
episodes.title: The Stronghold

episodes.synopsis: Maomao is accused of attempting to escape, and is tossed into an ancient method of torture and execution.
episodes.title: Taibon

episodes.synopsis: The royal guard, led by Jinshi, arrives, sealing the Shi clan's fate. Maomao wants to save her friend, Shisui.
episodes.title: Royal Guard

episodes.synopsis: Jinshi and his forces infiltrate the stronghold, cornering the remaining Shi clan members.
episodes.title: The Shi Clan

episodes.synopsis: After the war, Jinshi's work piles up and Maomao returns to the pleasure district.
episodes.title: The Beginning
